label: rem:glossary-exact-pairing
title: Exact pairing
html:
Exact pairing. Given objects X and Y in a monoidal category, an exact pairing consists of morphisms \varepsilon \colon X \otimes Y \to \mathbf{1} (evaluation) and \eta \colon \mathbf{1} \to Y \otimes X (coevaluation) satisfying the snake identities:

(\varepsilon \otimes \mathrm{id}_X) \circ (\mathrm{id}_X \otimes \eta) = \mathrm{id}_X, \qquad (\mathrm{id}_Y \otimes \varepsilon) \circ (\eta \otimes \mathrm{id}_Y) = \mathrm{id}_Y.

When an exact pairing exists, Y is a right dual of X, and X a left dual of Y.
